name: Gästehaus Maximilian
beschreibung: Gästehaus Maximilian is a traditional inn situated in Söll, Tyrol. The central location provides quick and convenient access to the mountain cable car. Inside, guests are welcomed by a peaceful and family-friendly atmosphere. The property offers comfortable, straightforward accommodations. The surrounding area boasts a wide variety of leisure activities in both summer and winter. Facilities include an on-site restaurant and Wi-Fi access.
